categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Landed in src/wallet/spend.cpp and labeled Wallet, modifying transaction creation weight validation.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where caller-specified `max_tx_weight` is ignored during wallet transaction creation when preset inputs fully cover the transaction amount. In `CreateTransactionInternal`, bypassing coin selection fell back to checking against `MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT` (400,000 WU) instead of the caller's parameter, allowing RPCs like `fundrawtransaction` to output transactions exceeding requested weight limits.
